_comment: Merged pull requests of the release range that deliberately have no CHANGELOG entry. scripts/check_changelog_completeness.py walks <previous_tag>..HEAD (both tags come from tests/coverage/release_record.json), derives every merged pull request number from the commit subjects, and fails unless each one is either referenced as #N in the changelog section for the release (or in [Unreleased]) or listed here. An entry names the pull request, a class from the gate's closed set (ci, test-only, docs-only, release-machinery, build-internal, merge-integration, reverted-or-superseded) and a specific reason a user cannot observe the change. The gate also fails an entry that is stale (not in the range), redundant (also referenced in the changelog: one home per pull request), duplicated, generically worded or out of order. Keep entries sorted by pull request number. A pull request may add its own entry before it merges: CI names it with --pending-pr, so the entry is not graded stale. The ledger is per release: when the release record's tag moves on, set "release" to the new tag and delete the entries the gate then reports as stale.

entries.reason: Adds an advisory placeholder job to the CI workflow and leaves every required lane unchanged; only .github/workflows/ci.yml is touched.
Replaces a placeholder completion-oracle target for a future milestone with per-deliverable criteria and the harness that emits them; oracle configuration and its test only.

Removes a duplicate push trigger, makes the docs-only changes gate fall back to running everything when its diff cannot be computed, and adds opt-in self-hosted lanes; workflow files and the contributor CI pages that describe them.

Extends the docs-only required-context stub job to every matrix-derived required context, adds the consistency checker that keeps it in step, and retries network setup steps; workflow and gate wiring only.

Adds the release's completion-oracle target, builds the quantum tree in the release readiness job, gives the evidence-staleness gate a NO_DATA verdict and derives key-space invariants from source; the documentation edits are line-count citation refreshes.
Moves the release readiness job in the release workflow onto a self-hosted runner label with a toolchain preflight step; one workflow file.
Behaviour-preserving split of the VM dispatch source file into operation, frame, control, limit and lifecycle modules; VM test subsets, parity results and the regenerated prelude cache are unchanged.

Adds a permanent regression fixture that checks an exact Jacobian determinant of a polynomial map through reverse-mode AD on both engines, with its ledger records; the fixes it pins landed in other pull requests.
Routes automatic pull-request and push CI to self-hosted capacity, keeps the hosted lanes as a manual fallback and adds the cost-policy check; workflows, CI scripts and their tests.
Makes the dataloader test call the canonical dataloader-has-next? name as well as its alias so the language-surface coverage gate records execution evidence for both; one test file.
Resizes the VM heap-budget watchdog fixture so it crosses the budget again after the closure-capture storage change shrank heap objects; the watchdog itself is unchanged.

Integration pull request that lands the release candidate branch on master; it has no change of its own, and the work it carries is accounted for under the individually numbered pull requests of this range and the entries of the release section.
Removes a merge-conflict marker that an earlier merge in this same release range left in a C source file outside the build's source list; no released build contained it.
Squash-merges the v1.3.5 release branch; every pull request it carried is accounted for individually through the release record's integration entry.
Makes the smoke probe for the large-procedure VM regression count the descriptive PASS lines that test prints, so a passing test is no longer reported red; one harness script.
Adds the Glorot initializer builtin names, which are public machine-learning vocabulary, to the disclosure gate's allowlist so the gate stops flagging the documented language surface.
Extends the object-header ratchet baseline to the seeded ESKM fuzz probe and rewords a self-test's negative case so the self-verdict scanner does not misread it; evidence hygiene for two gates.
Bounds the sanitizer lane's build parallelism and resizes the Windows ARM64 compile-time guards and a fast-pillar budget to the hosted runners' measured capacity; CI budgets only.
The ESKM preflight test runner no longer passes empty compiler arguments; test harness only.
